title: Prism icon registry
description: Semantic icon ids mapped to platform bindings. Agents use ids only; CI validates bindings against the Phosphor catalog (tools/icons) and SF Symbols availability (tools/icons-apple).

sources.description: The one open set (ADR-0013 decision 2) and the SF Symbols floor (critic C-21). Both are checked against the machine: the installed @phosphor-icons/core, and name_availability.plist on the macOS runner.

package.description: The only open icon set Prism binds on the web; a second set needs an ADR

version.description: Must equal the installed version of the package

release.description: SF Symbols release that ships with the floor OS (7 ships with OS 26)

maxYear.description: The newest name_availability.plist year key allowed: 2025 maps to OS 26.0, 2025.1 to 26.1 (critic C-21)

osFloor.description: The deployment floor of Package.swift: every symbol must be available at this iOS, macOS and watchOS release

weights.description: ds icon weight token -> platform weight. `number` is the number-to-name table the numeric tokens sys.icon.weight* resolve through (critic C-23).

sizes.description: The px icon boxes of ref.size.icon mapped to a measured SF point size (critic C-23). The point size is the one whose rendered `circle` at that scale is the box height within 1 px, at the Large content size; Dynamic Type scales both sides from there.

number.description: The font-weight number of the SF weight of the same name; the value a numeric icon-weight token carries

boldText.description: The weight this one steps to under Bold Text on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS; heavy steps to itself (ADR-0021 §3)

token.description: The token whose value must equal `px`

phosphor.description: '$weight' means use the weight cut; otherwise a Phosphor weight name such as fill or duotone

label.description: The id of the entry's meaning, for the registry, search, documentation and an app's own catalog; never an accessible name: a component is named only by the label its caller passes (ADR-0032 rule 6)

tags.description: Search terms an agent looks an icon up by (critic C-22, C-24): synonyms and the vendor metaphors, never a vendor name to render

phosphor.description: Phosphor kebab-case name; must exist in @phosphor-icons/core icons[].name (an alias warns and names the canonical)

apple.description: Exactly one binding: an SF Symbol, or an image set generated from the Phosphor cuts (ADR-0013 decision 3)

symbol.description: SF Symbol name; must be available at the osFloor of `sources` (SF Symbols 7 / OS 26)

minOS.description: The OS the symbol needs when it is newer than the floor; `fallback` is then required (critic C-21)

fallback.description: SF Symbol rendered below `minOS`; itself validated at the floor

custom.description: Image set generated from the Phosphor cuts into the DSIcons asset catalog (critic G-09); the id is also the asset name stem

rtlMirror.description: Per platform (critic C-24): `web` flips the glyph under dir=rtl; `apple` flips it in a right-to-left layout and must stay false for a symbol the system already mirrors: a backward/forward/leading/trailing name, or one of the few symbols SF Symbols draws right to left by itself (calendar, chart.xyaxis.line); a left/right name is not mirrored by the system, even one CoreGlyphs lists as legacy flippable. Checked by icons:validate and tools/icons-apple, and measured by DSIconBoxTests.
